These include monoethanolamine, diolamine, and trolamine laurilsulfates, and magnesium and ammonium lau- rilsulfates. Similar surfactants include sodium lauril ether sulfate and sodium alkyl sulfoacetates such as sodium lauril sulfoace- tate. Sodium laurilsulfate and related surfactants are also included in some combination preparations used rectally for the manage- ment of constipation. Preparations BP 2008: Emulsifying Wax.
